name: PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act)
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Perancangan siklus perbaikan berkelanjutan dan kontrol kualitas implementasi di lapangan
source_original.inputs: Rencana intervensi operasional dan metrik standar kinerja (*baseline*)
source_original.outputs: Siklus iterasi 4 tahap PDCA lengkap dengan ambang batas evaluasi *Check*

purpose: Plan a testable change and success criteria
activation_conditions: User requests PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Plan a testable change and success criteria
Do a bounded intervention with observation
Check outcomes against baseline and thresholds
Act by adopting, adjusting or abandoning and start the next cycle
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide pdca_cycle or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide thresholds or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide decision or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
